blurb: Guests meet near downtown Asheville at sunrise and are shuttled to a launch site for a 45 to 90 minute hot air balloon flight. Flights include a champagne toast and hors d’oeuvres after landing. Flights operate spring through fall, Friday through Monday, weather permitting.
extraNote: Two-week cancellation policy for full refund if canceled at least two weeks before flight · Cancellations within two weeks are transferable but non-refundable · No-shows charged full price · Flights are weather dependent and may be rescheduled or refunded if canceled by operator · Gift certificates are non-refundable but transferable and valid for one year · Ingles on Sand Hill Road, about 10 minutes from downtown Asheville · Spring through fall, Friday through Monday
